description: Transcribes an audio file (a public https URL or base64, up to 6 MB; WAV, MP3, M4A or OGG as the model accepts them) to text with a Cloudflare Workers AI Whisper model, returning the text and any timestamped segments the model gives. Requires the env.AI binding. Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

audioBase64.description: Or the audio itself: base64 data (no data: prefix), up to 6 MB decoded

audioUrl.description: Public https URL of the audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A or OGG), up to 6 MB

name: agent_intel_speech_to_text_transcribe_turbo
